idea: Signs of a hidden water leak
title: How to Spot Hidden Water Leaks Before They Cause Damage
description: Hidden water leaks inside walls or beneath floors can quietly cause costly structural damage long before you notice standing water. Pay attention to subtle early warning signs: unexpected spikes in your water bill, faint discolored patches or bubbling paint on drywall, unexplained dampness near baseboards, or the continuous faint sound of running water when all fixtures are turned off. To test for a leak, turn off every tap and water-using appliance in your home, then check your main water meter. If the leak indicator dial continues to move, water is escaping somewhere in your system. Contact a licensed plumber for professional leak detection.
